Meet the crew

HYROX Doncaster. From Tuesday-night classes to the unit.

Started as a handful of classes around Doncaster — HYROX, conditioning, strength — now it's a dedicated performance centre with simulations, a full race floor and a crew that shows up every week. Run by Nigel and the coaches you'll actually train with.

"HYROX isn't about who's strongest — it's about who keeps showing up. That's the whole game."

• Official HYROX affiliate — Doncaster
  • Regular in-house HYROX simulations (60+ athletes at the last one)
  • HYROX-certified coaching across strength, engine and race prep
alt="Nigel coaching a session at HYROX Doncaster in Doncaster"

Never raced and not sure where to start? Start here. One group session a week in Doncaster — start whenever, your own pace, nobody judging. Then once a month there's a meetup: class first, then coffee, food and gossip — and honestly, that's the important part. Sit with crew who've done it and see your next step in the flesh.

Weekly group session · monthly meetup — class first, then coffee and treats (the important part, honestly) · starter programme in the app · crew WhatsApp group. Walkers welcome — the podium's a bonus.

items.a: HYROX Doncaster publishes current prices with each six-week intake. Use the official website or message the gym directly for the next start date and price.
The current public starting point is a six-week introduction with limited places. Ask the gym directly if you need a shorter taster before committing.

items.q: I've never done HYROX — can beginners join?
items.a: Yes. The six-week introduction needs no previous HYROX experience. Movements are demonstrated, coached and scaled to your current level — no egos, no judgement.

An indoor fitness race: eight 1km runs with a workout station between each — SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jumps, row, farmers carry, lunges, wall balls. Open, Pro, Doubles and Relay divisions, so everyone can race.
Unit 9, Guildhall Industrial Estate, Kirk Sandall, Doncaster DN3 1QR. Check directly with the gym for arrival and parking instructions.
The current website states 17 coached sessions each week. Use the official HYROX Doncaster website or Instagram for the live timetable.

items.q: Do you run HYROX sim days?
items.a: Yes. Full simulations are open in announced categories to members and non-members, with real-time coaching, technique tweaks and race-condition practice. Dates are posted by the gym.
Public posts confirm personal training is available. Message HYROX Doncaster directly to ask about current 1:1 availability and the right starting point.
Ask HYROX Doncaster for the current membership and cancellation terms before joining; this preview does not invent contract details.

items.q: I'm looking for a doubles partner
items.a: Post a private card on the demo partner board with your pace band and target race. On launch, the gym would approve introductions without publishing phone numbers.
